buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Generic OPTION CLAUSE: The Purchaser reserves the right to increase or decrease the quantity to be ordered up to 25 percent of bid quantity at the time of placement of contract. The purchaser also reserves the right to increase the ordered quantity up to 25% of the contracted quantity during the currency of the contract at the contracted rates. The delivery period of quantity shall commence from the last date of original delivery order and in cases where option clause is exercised during the extended delivery period the additional time shall commence from the last date of extended delivery period. The additional delivery time shall be (Increased quantity ÷ Original quantity) × Original delivery period (in days), subject to minimum of 30 days. If the original delivery period is less than 30 days, the additional time equals the original delivery period. The Purchaser may extend this calculated delivery duration up to the original delivery period while exercising the option clause. Bidders must comply with these terms. 2. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses 1. 1. Site Visit: Bidders are advised to personally visit and examine the installati on site and surrounding conditions at their own responsibility and cost before pr eparing their bids. The site is located at Sports Ground, Junagadh Agricultural University, Junagadh. 362 001. All expenses related to the site visit shall be borne by the bidder. Bidders who fail to conduct a site visit shall n ot be entitled to claim non-compliance, lack of information, or any misunderstan ding regarding site conditions, as it is the sole responsibility of the bidder to ass ess site-specific requirements prior to bid submission. It is mandatory for all bid ders to obtain a site visit certificate from the Buyer or designated Consignee an d upload it with the bid documents; failure to submit the certificate will lead to disqualification of the bid. 2. Manufacturer’s Authorization Form (MAF): The bidder is required to submit a bid-specific Manufacturer’s Authorization Form (MAF) issued by t he Original Equipment Manufacturer (OEM) for the following items: CCTV Camera, NVR and Rack. The Buyer reserves the right to verify the authent icity of the MAF directly with the OEM. Submission of forged, false, or fabri cated documents will result in immediate disqualification from the bidding process. 3. Compliance with “Make in India” Initiative: The proposed product must conform to the “Make in India” guidelines. A detailed product catalo

gue and datasheet—issued either by the OEM or the bidder—must be encl osed with the bid. The submitted information will be cross-verified with th e official OEM website. Any mismatch or unverifiable data will result in im mediate disqualification. 4. Local Office Requirement: The OEM or bidder must have a functional office in the state of Gujarat with a dedicated service and support contact number to ensure prompt assistance and support. 5. Certification Standards: The OEM must hold valid certifications for the following standards: ISO 9001, ISO 14001, and ISO 27001. Supporting cer tificates must be submitted along with the bid. 6. Delivery, Installation, and Commissioning: The bidder shall be resp onsible for the supply and laying of CAT-6 Ethernet cables with conduit pipes (approximately 1000 meters), mounting of cameras with junction bo xes, NVR configuration, and termination of RJ-45 connectors and provision of all other required accessories. The bidder shall also carry out final testi ng and commissioning of the system. Final payment will be released only upon successful and satisfactory completion of installation and training ac tivities. 7. Declaration of Non-Blacklisting: Bidders are required to submit a dec laration on non-judicial stamp paper of ₹300/-, certifying that they are not blacklisted by any Government or Semi-Government authority. The declar ation also includes unconditional acceptance of all terms and conditions s pecified in the tender document, as outlined in Annexure I. The stamp p aper shall be issued and dated after the tender publication date. 8. OEM Experience: The Original Equipment Manufacturer (OEM) shall pos sess a minimum of five (5) years of experience in the CCTV camera and re lated business. Supporting documentary evidence to substantiate this experience, including the Certificate of Incorporation, shall be submitted a long with the bid. 9. For compliance, the CCTV cameras and NVRs shall be from the same Ori ginal Equipment Manufacturer (OEM). 10. GeM Rating Criteria: The bidder must have a GeM rating of 4.00 or hig her. Any bidder flagged in red on the GeM portal shall be disqualified with out exception. 11. Right to Cancel: The University reserves the absolute right to cancel th e bidding process at any stage, without assigning any reason whatsoever. 12. The bid shall be evaluated for all the items together. 13. Product Brochure: The bidder shall upload the product brochures of th e CCTV cameras, NVRs and rack, clearly indicating the brand and model n umber. . 3.
